title: Word-aligned length-64 product with five independent extra parity coordinates

claims.statement: For the explicit product of 31 systematic [64,32] components and one [16,8] tail, and the counted marked-syndrome decoder of proof.md, the average block error for uniform 1000-bit data on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 999901937718137651/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=454 primitives on every received word and W<=2^(176531/20000).

experiments.purpose: Verify complete exact syndrome leader and reserved-address histograms in each invariant sector, exact product bound, and the fixed schedule in sector zero.
